rateLimits.note: "1000 requests per minute from the same IP address" (API reference): counted for the whole application, the stricter form when it runs on several addresses.

provenance.notes: The API reference (read 2026-11-10) gives 1,000 requests per minute per source IP and no status or header for it; a 429 and its Retry-After are honoured when Gandi sends them. The contracts page lists the General Terms (MSA 2020.1.1), the Reseller contract and the OAuth 2.0 special conditions as PDFs; none of them is read here for an API usage clause, so commercial use, caching and storage are unknown. A personal access token is required. The sandbox (api.sandbox.gandi.net) is a separate account.
